name: Nick Bellistri
headline: Senior Product Manager — AI product, B2B SaaS, platform
resume_summary: Nick Bellistri is a product manager with 15+ years across B2B SaaS, AI/ML, fintech and marketing technology. At HubSpot he is a Senior Product Manager on Marketing Studio, owning campaign creation and AI-generated campaign assets, plus the company framework for AI output quality: prompt engineering, model selection, context quality and evaluation. He is leading Campaign Creation 2.0, a multi-modal experience with four entry points (asset-first, AI chat, insight-driven and canvas), and proposed a Campaign Planning Hub that converts unstructured planning documents into structured inputs, backed by an opportunity solution tree. Earlier he built generative AI and platform features at Orum for a sales-calling product, shipped wealth management tooling for financial advisors at Addepar, and worked on retirement plan and participant experience products at John Hancock. He runs continuous competitive analysis of marketing automation platforms and works hands-on in Amplitude, Snowflake, Looker, SQL and Python. He holds an MBA from Quantic and a BA in English and Professional Writing.

Platform or internal tooling where the users are other product and engineering teams

Fully remote in the US, or Boston-area hybrid at two to three days per week
Staff, principal, group or lead PM scope; director of product at a small or mid-size company
Fintech, martech or wealth management domains where prior context compounds
